requested.label: Requested
requested.help: We've received your request and will reply by email, usually within two business days.

approved.label: Approved
approved.help: Your return was approved. Send the items back as described in our email; we will let you know when they arrive.

rejected.label: Not approved
rejected.help: We couldn't accept this return. Our email explains why; reply to it if you have questions.

received.label: Items received
received.help: The items arrived and we're checking them. Your refund or replacement follows.

refunded.label: Refunded
refunded.help: Refunded by the method you paid with; your bank may take a few days to show it.

notes.giftCard: Paid in full with a gift card. Thank you.
notes.rewardPoints: Paid in full with reward points. Thank you.
notes.refunded: Your payment was refunded in full, by the same method you paid with.
notes.partlyRefunded: Part of your payment was refunded, by the same method you paid with. See the refunds below.
notes.cardOn: Paid by card on {{date}}. Thank you.
notes.paypalOn: Paid with PayPal on {{date}}. Thank you.
notes.sslOn: Paid through SSLCommerz on {{date}}. Thank you.
notes.review: We've received your payment and are checking it. We'll email you as soon as your order is confirmed.
notes.cancelled: This order was cancelled, so nothing will be charged.
notes.cod: Pay the courier when your order arrives.
notes.awaitPaypal: Awaiting payment: nothing has been charged yet. Approve the payment on PayPal's site with Pay now. If it isn't completed in time, the order is cancelled and the items are released.
notes.awaitSslcommerz: Awaiting payment: nothing has been charged yet. Pay with bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or a card on SSLCommerz's secure page with Pay now. If it isn't completed in time, the order is cancelled and the items are released.
notes.awaitStripe: Awaiting payment: nothing has been charged yet. Pay by card on Stripe's secure page; BuyNest never sees your card number. If the payment isn't completed in time, the order is cancelled and the items are released.
notes.manual: Nothing has been charged. Online payments happen on the provider's secure page, which BuyNest hasn't connected yet: we'll email you about paying, and your items stay reserved meanwhile.
notes.codPartlyPaid: Delivery charge of {{advance}} paid in advance. Please keep {{due}} ready to pay in cash on delivery.
notes.codAdvanceDue: Pay the delivery charge online to confirm this order; the rest is paid in cash on delivery. Nothing has been charged yet.
notes.codDue: Please keep {{due}} ready to pay in cash on delivery.

view.byEmail: Sent by email: nothing to ship.
view.verified: Prices verified with the server (DummyJSON cart #{{cart}}). Its own discounted total was {{total}}, rounded to whole dollars, before coupons and shipping.
